Amazon EC2 **m7i.large** pricing and specifications vary by purchasing option and region (such as standard Linux pricing in US East):[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://www.devzero.io/instances/aws/m7i.large)

### Specifications

- **vCPUs:** 2
- **Memory:** 8 GiB (4 GiB per vCPU)
- **Processor:** 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable (Sapphire Rapids, 3.2 GHz)
- **Network Bandwidth:** Up to 12.5 Gbps (EBS-optimized)[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)

### Pricing Breakdown (Linux / US Dollar / No Upfront)

- **On-Demand:** ~$0.1008 per hour (~$73.58 per month)[[1]](https://costcalc.cloudoptimo.com/aws-pricing-calculator/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)
- **Spot:** ~$0.0366 to $0.0441 per hour (depending on the availability zone)[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://calculator.holori.com/aws/ec2/m7i.large)
- **1-Year Reserved / EC2 Instance Savings Plan:** ~$0.0667 per hour (~$48.68 per month)[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://calculator.holori.com/aws/ec2/m7i.large)
- **3-Year Reserved / EC2 Instance Savings Plan:** ~$0.0457 to $0.046 per hour (~$33.38 per month)[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://calculator.holori.com/aws/ec2/m7i.large)

You can check live rates or compare other sizes via [Vantage](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large) or [Holori](https://calculator.holori.com/aws/ec2/m7i.large).[[1]](https://instances.vantage.sh/aws/ec2/m7i.large)[[2]](https://calculator.holori.com/aws/ec2/m7i.large)If you need pricing for a **different region**, **operating system (like Windows)** , or a **different instance size** (like `m7i.xlarge` ), let me know and I can pull those exact numbers for you.
